scope: Requirement-fit and repository-quality source review for research runtimes and memory alternatives, with coverage pointers for all 20 existing layers. The snapshot was observed September 22 UTC while still September 21 in New York. No installations, native model calls, broker operations or upstream test runs were performed by this source-review work. Native runtime review and clean-install checks, if separately recorded, have their own receipts.

criteria.question: Does the repository implement the required task and integrate with the chosen native clients?
acceptable_evidence: Pinned primary implementation/docs for candidate eligibility
Matching completed native operation for local acceptance
criteria.limits: Feature descriptions establish a plausible capability, not our outcome or a comparative winner.

criteria.question: What unchanged upstream tests, examples and independent local observations support the claim?
acceptable_evidence: Actual returned outcomes tied to input, oracle and revision
criteria.limits: A test file or CI badge is not a passed local test; agent agreement is not an independent correctness oracle.

criteria.question: Is the reviewed implementation active and reproducibly identifiable?
acceptable_evidence: Observed release metadata with component scope
criteria.limits: Recent commits, a latest-release label and stars are not reliability scores. A repository-level release may concern a different subpackage; dependency compatibility remains untested.

criteria.question: Does the selected implementation and deployment fit local WSL, account and licensing requirements?
acceptable_evidence: Provider/deployment docs for the selected profile
Qualified native authentication and network boundaries
criteria.limits: License metadata and a local-install recipe do not qualify the whole dependency tree or prove offline execution.

criteria.question: Can the owned runtime install, restart, restore and uninstall without losing or crossing scoped state?
acceptable_evidence: Matching clean-host installation and useful native behavior
Scoped backup, cleanup and sign-in observations
criteria.limits: Historical same-host success does not establish clean WSL, off-host recovery or a different revision.

criteria.question: What is the complete measured cost at matched answer/task quality?
acceptable_evidence: Provider usage including retries, failed tasks, caches, embeddings, extraction and orchestration
Measured latency/resource use with a fixed task and quality oracle
criteria.limits: Unknown when no matched comparison exists; free/local/subscription descriptions and output compression counters are not complete operating-cost results.

claim_limits: This review is a bounded challenger refresh, not exhaustive evaluation of all 525 discovery identities or every repository linked by an awesome list.

188 baseline candidate-layer rows represented 150 case-insensitive repository identities; after this refresh 207 rows represent 157 identities. Candidate-layer decisions and unique repositories are different counts.
Source findings are upstream-supported capabilities; they are not proof of local behavior or superiority.
The six qualitative criteria do not produce a numeric quality score or a universal winner.
Existing accepted pins, historical receipts and their failures remain unchanged; a newer reviewed commit is not installed by inclusion.
Published benchmark scores are not compared across unmatched workloads, providers, contexts or evaluation protocols.
The ai-memory selection remains keep-but-compare; useful learning, held-out recall and complete comparative cost are not closed.
Runtime reviewers can expose missing evidence, but more harnesses or reviewer agreement cannot establish truth or a definitive state-of-the-art ranking.

layer_coverage.requirement: Run coding and bounded research with existing native accounts, client tools, model choices and resumable sessions.
layer_coverage.current_choice: Native Codex and Claude Code; application SDKs only for a demonstrated application requirement.
layer_coverage.evidence_gap: The recorded tasks do not establish a comparative model-quality ranking or causal provider savings. Same-session continuation does not establish every crash, provider cancellation or cross-host recovery condition.
layer_coverage.overturn_when: A required structured-event, custom-tool or application state capability is unavailable through the native path and a supported SDK implementation passes the same task, account, effect and recovery checks.

layer_coverage.requirement: Give each task concise canonical rules and useful upstream procedures without activating whole instruction or plugin catalogs.
layer_coverage.current_choice: Selected ECC search-first/iterative-retrieval skills, native project instructions, on-demand references and the optional Agent Skills reference validator; task-selected TypeSafe, gh-fix-ci and security-best-practices for Codex/Claude.
layer_coverage.evidence_gap: The community-practice review records no measured task-quality improvement or provider-cost change. Reference format validation does not establish support for every client extension or successful activation.
layer_coverage.overturn_when: A specific task exposes a missing procedure, and a pinned candidate works in native discovery and task execution with less conflict or better measured results than the current procedure.

layer_coverage.requirement: Delegate bounded independent work, preserve owned edits and actual failed results, and integrate only after relevant review.
layer_coverage.current_choice: Native Claude/Codex workers with owned Worktrunk worktrees; optional Beads when dependency tracking is needed, optional qualified cross-client review and an opt-in semantic-evidence-reviewer with explicit TypeSafe context.
layer_coverage.evidence_gap: Graceful native Workflow resume is separate from the systemd child-crash fixture; neither transfers every hard-crash guarantee to the other. The restricted reviewer tool profile is not the accepted inherited-tool lane. The older companion backend acceptance does not certify every outer plugin invocation. Native model/effort settings are inherited and returned identities recorded. Skill propagation is not a universal runtime/model ranking; account scopes and failed read paths remain evidence. The September 21 New York / September 22 UTC source refresh adds Deep Agents, OpenHands SDK/Agent Canvas, Microsoft Agent Framework and DeerFlow comparisons. It does not install them or establish a head-to-head worker winner; historical DeerFlow adapter evidence applies only to its recorded revision.
layer_coverage.overturn_when: A real task needs durable multi-host state, approval waits or effect recovery beyond native workers, and one challenger passes frozen cancellation, replay, ownership and integration cases.

layer_coverage.requirement: Separate edits and apply a real filesystem/network boundary only where the selected task requires enforced restrictions.
layer_coverage.current_choice: Worktrunk/Git worktrees for edit ownership and sandbox-runtime for qualified Linux restrictions. Apple Container remains conditional on an eligible macOS host and a matching container requirement.
layer_coverage.evidence_gap: A worktree is not a security sandbox. Ordinary native or Dagu processes are not automatically sandboxed. Selected access/network fixtures do not certify hostile workloads, resource limits or unsupported platforms.
layer_coverage.overturn_when: Untrusted code or a deployment target requires a stronger VM/OCI boundary, and the selected alternative passes workload, network, resource, cleanup and host compatibility checks.

layer_coverage.requirement: Retrieve exact source and references for changes with a conceptual or structural index only when it answers the actual question.
layer_coverage.current_choice: Focused source reads, Serena symbols, ast-grep, scoped codebase-memory and jCodeMunch; SocratiCode handles conceptual search in the semantic layer.
layer_coverage.evidence_gap: Compressed structure and symbol indexes omit implementation details; correctness still requires original source. No representative cross-repository or cross-language benchmark establishes a global best code retriever.
layer_coverage.overturn_when: A sealed task set in the target languages shows a challenger returning more correct source/references at an acceptable total indexing, retrieval and maintenance cost.

layer_coverage.requirement: Find source-grounded Markdown/document content with controlled ingestion and retrieve the original body before relying on a result.
layer_coverage.current_choice: Scoped QMD BM25; Context Hub for selected developer docs; MarkItDown HTML and Poppler PDF conversion in their accepted scopes.
layer_coverage.evidence_gap: The QMD diagnostic used one ordered run and an incompletely sealed expanded index; it is not a general retrieval ranking. HTML/PDF fixtures do not qualify arbitrary Office documents, scans, tables or filing layouts. Context Hub's retained size comparison grew by 85 tokens.
layer_coverage.overturn_when: A sealed representative corpus/query set shows useful quality gains with acceptable repeated end-to-end latency, or layout/OCR failures justify a separately qualified parser.

layer_coverage.requirement: Answer conceptual code questions using a scoped local index and a compatible embedding service, with recoverable state.
layer_coverage.current_choice: SocratiCode, Qdrant and the accepted vLLM/Nemotron embedding runtime; use exact source navigation after retrieval.
layer_coverage.evidence_gap: Four paired upstream examples first-ranked correctly establish compatibility, not a held-out domain or cross-model benchmark. The vLLM compatibility pin is host-specific; the retained newer-version initialization failure is not a failure of other serving repositories.
layer_coverage.overturn_when: A sealed project/domain retrieval set shows improved source-grounded quality and acceptable latency, memory and lifecycle costs, or a supported target model cannot run in the current service.

layer_coverage.requirement: Keep scoped decisions, handoffs and useful learning available across native Codex and Claude with inspectable capture, deletion and recovery.
layer_coverage.current_choice: One ai-memory store as the cross-client memory of record; retain separate code, document and transient-context retrieval layers.
layer_coverage.evidence_gap: Scheduler admission does not establish learned-write quality; the retained model review rejected insufficient evidence. Bounded sanitized assistant excerpts are not complete transcripts, and exact lifetime memory token savings are unknown. Current primary-source review corrects manual-only, Claude-only and cloud-only exclusions. No matched memory benchmark or new installation was run; automatic capture, local providers and published scores remain source claims until exercised on the selected profile.
layer_coverage.overturn_when: An isolated representative corpus and question set shows better source-grounded recall/usefulness and acceptable complete provider use, latency, capture/deletion and restore behavior without ambiguous memory ownership.

layer_coverage.requirement: Retrieve attributable primary sources and interact with selected pages through bounded native commands without another standing research-agent stack.
layer_coverage.current_choice: agent-browser, selected Playwright CLI operations, OpenResearch literature retrieval and Tavily CLI search/extract skills.
layer_coverage.evidence_gap: Accepted public-source retrieval is not an exhaustive research-quality benchmark or a guarantee of citation correctness. Optional hosted services, credentials and bulk crawling require task-specific qualification; source-screened alternatives were not runtime tested.
layer_coverage.overturn_when: A defined source-coverage or ingestion task exceeds the current commands and a candidate improves attributable retrieval completeness, accuracy and total runtime/cost on the same frozen source set.

layer_coverage.requirement: Supply useful task context with recoverable originals and measure artifact reductions separately from provider usage.
layer_coverage.current_choice: Focused reads and scoped retrieval first; task-selected RTK, Context Mode and explicit-file Repomix; optional guarded Headroom and TOON only after a suitable same-artifact comparison; ccusage observes native usage.
layer_coverage.evidence_gap: The current native tasks have no matched baseline; counters, bytes avoided, artifact token counts and provider usage must not be summed. TOON expands the full catalog relative to compact JSON; guarded compression must return originals on rejection. Exact whole-PC lifetime savings are unmeasured.
layer_coverage.overturn_when: A frozen task/artifact and repeated controlled comparison improves answer correctness or retrieval completeness while reducing complete provider use or latency, with successful raw-input recovery.

layer_coverage.requirement: Verify the changed behavior using relevant upstream/project checks, independent observations and explicit failure-preserving evidence.

MCP Inspector supports scoped protocol checks; TypeSafe supplies task-specific advisory judgments, and selected OpenAI skills supply CI or security procedures when needed.
layer_coverage.evidence_gap: Promptfoo's earlier echo fixture and later four-pair upstream example are not held-out model-quality evaluations. Local test totals, structural validation and reviewer agreement cannot establish upstream end-to-end behavior. TypeSafe matched 7/8 pre-inference labels versus 3/8 for weak literal containment. The disagreement, selected small corpus and unmatched native review prevent a universal quality, speed or cost ranking.
layer_coverage.overturn_when: A defined tool-use/extraction or experiment-tracking requirement cannot be expressed adequately in the current test lane and a challenger passes a representative frozen oracle with usable failure inspection.

layer_coverage.requirement: Publish reproducible changes with scoped workflow permissions, pinned dependencies, actual runtime inventory and attributable hosted checks.

layer_coverage.evidence_gap: Syntax/security checks do not execute a workflow or prove model-task quality. Syft inventory is not a vulnerability verdict. The recorded first Dependabot scans do not establish the scheduled weekly time or every grouped update. Existing automation sources are broader than the repository decision-index union.
layer_coverage.overturn_when: A specific dependency/update or vulnerability gap is demonstrated and one alternative covers it with pinned database/provenance, manageable findings and no duplicate ownership of the same dependency.

layer_coverage.overturn_when: Real jobs require host-loss survival, days-long waits or durable cross-host effects, and one challenger passes the declared effect/retry/recovery cases with acceptable operational burden.

layer_coverage.evidence_gap: A local fixture and service UI are not production readiness, scalability or paid-hosting acceptance. Gateway dashboard/lifecycle evidence is separate from a successful exact-model task; recorded route/provider refusals remain limits.
layer_coverage.overturn_when: A defined production, remote-team or GPU deployment requirement exceeds the local fixture, and one alternative passes its account, data, networking, rollback and workload-cost acceptance.

layer_coverage.requirement: Reproduce selected tools and recover actual application state on an explicitly adopted host without copying authentication stores or treating old receipts as new acceptance.

layer_coverage.evidence_gap: Synthetic off-host/guest cases and a clean hosted runner do not certify the new physical PC, GPU, secrets or all application state. Native sign-ins and host-specific acceptance remain necessary; rollback and hash checks alone do not prove a model task or service recovery.
layer_coverage.overturn_when: A real multi-language/system dependency or state-loss case exceeds the selected recipes, and the proposed environment/backup alternative passes install, restore, resume and cleanup on the target host.

layer_coverage.requirement: Observe real native usage/service outcomes through one privacy-filtered local pipeline and qualify any optional model route on its actual workload.
layer_coverage.current_choice: OTel Collector Contrib, Prometheus/Loki/Grafana, Alertmanager/ntfy, scoped AgentsView/otel-tui and the native Claude HUD; inference/gateway trials retain separate qualification.
layer_coverage.evidence_gap: Source time differs from scrape time; usage differs from savings. The current interactive HUD evidence does not certify every statistic or automatic compaction. Local generation and gateway acceptance are route/workload-specific; catalog presence is not a passed exact-model task.
layer_coverage.overturn_when: A required trace, evaluation or supported model/hardware workload is unanswerable by the current path, and one alternative passes privacy, fidelity, latency/cost and recovery comparisons without duplicate capture.

layer_coverage.requirement: Keep durable project knowledge, exact code and dated financial sources retrievable across native clients, with source recovery, explicit project scope and measurable retrieval quality.
layer_coverage.current_choice: ai-memory as the shared memory of record; QMD BM25 for documents; Serena for exact symbols; SocratiCode with Qdrant for conceptual code search; Context Mode and RTK for selected large outputs. These are complementary lanes, not one benchmark winner.
layer_coverage.evidence_gap: Twelve curated queries are a bounded diagnostic, not an independent holdout or a complete financial RAG evaluation. Exact-source recall at three was 8/12; misses remain recorded. The eight native answer invocations form four within-provider task comparisons; two Claude full-context answers missed the word protocol and one focused Codex answer scored 9.5 versus 10. These are not general or causal savings results. Same-host encrypted restore preserved application state, but independent key recovery, off-host durability and new-host client rebinding remain unqualified. Alternative memory and RAG repositories below were generally source-reviewed, not run head-to-head. A source-only candidate has not failed. Current primary-source review corrects manual-only, Claude-only and cloud-only exclusions. No matched memory benchmark or new installation was run; automatic capture, local providers and published scores remain source claims until exercised on the selected profile.
layer_coverage.overturn_when: Run a preregistered, representative held-out financial/document and code retrieval set at the same context budget; replace or supplement a lane only if a candidate improves source/answer fidelity, abstention and measured task cost while preserving isolation, exact source recovery and native client behavior.

layer_coverage.requirement: Run bounded research with native identity and complete returned results; supervise owned processes; retain scoped telemetry, failed attempts and recoverable state without granting research workers broker execution authority.
layer_coverage.current_choice: Native Codex and Claude for bounded research and review; Dagu/systemd for selected local command workflows; one OpenTelemetry Collector with Prometheus/Loki/Grafana; native sandboxing and Restic for their separately qualified scopes. Optional gateways and agent frameworks remain task-specific.
layer_coverage.evidence_gap: Native worker success and telemetry matching are bounded by the recorded task, process and account. They do not establish every native client/session, whole-task savings or unlimited allowance. Dagu's older completed-history restart is not in-flight recovery. Later recovery receipts must be evaluated for their own process, host and workload rather than promoting all workflows. Gateway transport health, routed text and ACP research acceptance do not establish native hook/tool parity or independent provider/model attestation. Same-host recovery and configured restrictions do not establish off-host disaster recovery, a VM boundary, unattended broker operation or paid hosting.
layer_coverage.overturn_when: Escalate to another scheduler, graph or host only when a specified long-running workflow, host-loss recovery, asset/backfill lineage or scale requirement exceeds the retained lane and the candidate passes the same failure, cancellation, output, identity and usage checks without duplicate effect owners.

layer_coverage.requirement: Acquire licensed, source-identifiable US-equity observations; preserve feed, timestamps, identity and corporate actions; produce exact reproducible analytical snapshots and reject data whose historical availability or eligibility is unknown.

Numeric corporate-action values matched the frozen probe, but missing dividend currency prevented full cash-unit reconciliation. Original historical availability and complete action coverage remain open. Three documentary lifecycle cases preserve observed cutoffs and source anchors; retrospective claims do not establish historical as-known eligibility or permanent security identity. The prior SEC HTTP 403 remains a historical failure. Later corrected acquisition and parsing qualify their selected requests only; no general filing-completeness or strategy-validity claim follows. SQL, schemas and content hashes cannot repair missing provenance, revised fundamentals, access rights or outcome-selected samples.
layer_coverage.overturn_when: Freeze required universe/history/latency, rights, correction and availability semantics; compare selected providers on representative securities including delistings, ticker reuse and corporate actions, then change the feed/store only when a candidate closes those gaps with auditable records and acceptable measured cost. Add a server or lake only after local throughput/concurrency measurements justify it.

In-flight native failure cases, IBKR, live operation and continuous paper operation remain open. No accepted point-in-time universe, extreme-mover/catalyst strategy, financing-inclusive performance or deployable profitability follows from these receipts.
layer_coverage.overturn_when: Reopen the implementation choice if Nautilus cannot preserve a required cash/order semantic, fails a preregistered SPY/LEAN parity tolerance, or a broker-specific adapter cannot pass ownership, reconciliation, partial/cancel/reconnect and numeric risk cases. Compare alternatives on the same frozen inputs and failure contract; promote a strategy only after independent temporal and cost-aware evaluation.
